name: The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth+
_note: Issue #32. Official achievements (Steam 250900, ids 1-637: Rebirth, Afterbirth, Afterbirth+, Booster Packs, Repentance DLC). The save keeps one byte per achievement id at 0x20 + id; "needs" skips ids beyond the save's achievement table (no DLC yet). Layout from PC saves (zamiell/isaac-save-installer); the Switch file names are a guess: not checked on a console yet, the header check keeps a different layout locked.
